name: Toil
overview: Scripture reveals that toil is a consequence of mankind's fall, as God declared the ground cursed and labor would be accompanied by sorrow (Genesis 3:17). However, diligent work is not without value, for it brings profit and blessing when done under the Lord’s guidance (Proverbs 14:23; Proverbs 10:22). The psalmist reminds believers that human effort apart from God is ultimately in vain, emphasizing the necessity of depending on the Lord’s provision and rest (Psalms 127:1-2). Thus, toil is both a sobering reality and a context for trusting God’s blessing and sovereignty in our daily labor.
